_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-33, NARROWED. FP-D has two correct outcomes and they are opposites: a diagram citing only src/a.ts renders, and a diagram citing an invented path is dropped entirely. Which one occurs depends on whether the model hallucinates on this run, so neither the presence nor the absence of a Mermaid block can be asserted without flaking. What is mechanical is that the drop is SILENT — a dropped diagram must never leave a parse error or a stray empty fence behind.
